children: ), holding company of The Northern Trust Company, has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.88 per share on its common stock ($1.66-2/3 par value), payable on January 1, 2027, to holders of record at 5:00 p.m., Chicago time, on December 4, 2026.

Northern Trust Corporation also declared a cash dividend of $293.75 per share of its Series E non-cumulative perpetual preferred stock (resulting in a distribution of $0.29375 per depository share), payable on January 1, 2027, to holders of record at 5:00 p.m., Chicago time, on December 15, 2026.

Northern Trust also announced that its Board of Directors has approved a new common stock repurchase authorization of up to $3.5 billion of the Corporation’s outstanding common stock. The new authorization will take effect upon completion of the existing $2.5 billion share repurchase authorization approved in July 2025. The timing and amount of shares repurchased under the authorizations will depend on various factors, including, but not limited to, Northern Trust’s business plans, financial performance, other investment opportunities, and general market conditions, including share price.

As of June 30, 2026, Northern Trust had assets under custody/administration of US$20.0 trillion, and assets under management of US$2.0 trillion.
